'''Mos Nytram''' was a remote [[City/Legends|town]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] purchased his [[Zephyr-G swoop/Legends|Zephyr-G swoop]] from an auction there.
